Satellite imagery indicate that showers and thunderstorms associated  with an area of low pressure, located several hundred miles  west-southwest of the Cabo Verde Islands, have become better  organized tonight. If the current trends continue, advisories could  be initiated on a short-lived tropical depression or storm later  today. However, environmental conditions are expected to become  hostile beginning on Friday, likely ending its chances for  development. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...high...70 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...70 percent.

Showers and thunderstorms are beginning to show signs of  organization in association with a low pressure system located about  800 miles southwest of the coast of southwestern Mexico.  Environmental conditions are expected to support continued  development of this system, and a tropical depression is expected to  form later today or tonight. The system is forecast to move  west-northwestward at 10 to 15 mph, well offshore of Mexico. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...high...90 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...90 percent.

An area of low pressure is forecast to form this weekend well to the  south of southwestern Mexico. Environmental conditions appear  favorable for gradual development of this system, and a tropical  depression is likely to form early next week while it moves westward  to west-northwestward at 10 to 15 mph.  
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

An area of low pressure located well east-southeast of the Hawaiian  Islands continues to produce disorganized showers and thunderstorms.  Environmental conditions appear conducive for gradual development,  and a tropical depression is likely to form over the next two or  three days while the system drifts to the northeast, before turning  westward this weekend. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...60 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

An area of low pressure could form well south of the Hawaiian  Islands over the weekend or early next week. Some gradual  development is possible thereafter while the system moves slowly  west-northwestward, well south-southwest of the Hawaiian Islands. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.
